Visual artist Jason Cook  creates kinetic sculptures and robotic installations using electronics, programming and mechanical engineering. In The Walking Chair (2025), an ordinary wooden chair is transformed into a moving machine. A system of motors, mechanical parts and electronic components is attached beneath the seat, allowing the chair’s legs to move. By giving a familiar piece of furniture the ability to walk, Cook changes the way we perceive an everyday object. The chair is no longer simply something we sit on  it becomes an object with a movement of its own. #art #artist #weird #chair #avantgarde

Takeout-Style Chicken Onion Stir-Fry Ingredients: Chicken breast, thinly sliced 1 onion, sliced into strips Spring onion, cut into sections Ginger slices Minced garlic Oil for cooking A pinch of salt ½ cup water Marinade: 1 tbsp soy sauce 1 tsp dark soy sauce ½ tbsp oyster sauce 1 tbsp cooking wine 1 tsp baking soda 1 tsp sugar 1 tsp chicken powder Black pepper 1 tbsp corn starch ½ tbsp sesame oil Steps: 1 Slice the chicken breast thinly. 2 Add soy sauce, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, cooking wine, baking soda, sugar, chicken powder, black pepper, corn starch, and sesame oil. Mix well and marinate for 15 minutes. 3 Slice the onion into strips. Cut the spring onion into sections, keeping the white and green parts separate. 4 Heat a little oil in a pan. Add the onion with a pinch of salt and stir-fry for 1 minute. Remove and set aside. 5 Add a little more oil if needed. Add ginger slices, minced garlic, chicken, and the white part of the spring onion. 6 Spread the chicken out and let it sear, then flip and stir-fry until cooked. 7 Add about ½ cup water. The corn starch from the chicken will loosen into the sauce and make it thick and glossy, so you don’t need extra corn starch slurry. 8 Add the green part of the spring onion and the cooked onion back in. Toss everything together and serve with rice. #ChickenStirFry #TakeoutStyle #EasyDinner #ChineseCooking #RiceBowl

videos.caption: YALL COME EAT it’s my viral sausage tortellini. 🤤  This recipe has nearly 5 million views on TikTok, so I thought it was time for an official step-by-step.  1. Cook 1 bag of tortellini according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add 2 packs of sliced andouille sausage and cook until browned and heated through. Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

WHAT YOU’LL NEED: Honey Garlic Chicken • 800g chicken breast, cubed • 1.5 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 1 tsp chilli flakes • 1.5 tsp garlic powder • 1.5 tsp onion powder • 1.5 tsp smoked paprika • 2 tsp olive oil • 30g light butter • 2 tsp minced garlic • 30g honey • Handful fresh parsley, chopped Garlic Mac & Cheese • 220g uncooked macaroni • 1 large tbsp minced garlic • 300ml skimmed milk • 160g light cream cheese • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp smoked paprika • ½ tsp nutmeg • 100g low-fat cheddar cheese HOW TO MAKE IT: 1. Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, chilli flakes, garlic powder, onion powder and smoked paprika. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat with the olive oil and some of the butter. Add the chicken and cook for 4–5 minutes until golden, flip and cook for another 3–4 minutes until cooked through. 3. Lower the heat and add the remaining butter, minced garlic and honey. Give it a mixy mixy motherfucker! until the chicken is coated in that sticky honey garlic goodness. Remove and set aside. 4. Cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions. 5. In the same pan, cook the minced garlic in the leftover buttery goodness for around 2 minutes. 6. Add the skimmed milk, light cream cheese, salt, black pepper, smoked paprika and nutmeg. Stir until smooth. 7. Lower the heat, add the cheddar and stir until melted. Add the cooked macaroni and give the whole thing another mixy mixy motherfucker! 8. Serve the mac & cheese topped with the sticky honey garlic chicken and finish with fresh parsley. VIRAL BROTHY BEEF BOWLS 🔥 If you love soup recipes, but want something substantial and super filling, these are one of the best easy weeknight meals. It’s so easy to make, so good, and packed with protei and flavor. These are super filling and come in under 500 calories and 35g protein a bowl. One of my favorite protein hacks is using a really good bone broth.That little Kettle & Fire carton has almost 20g of protein on its own, I used up a cup in the broth, and a cup making the rice instead of water to boost the protein + flavor. Here is how I made it: 1️⃣ Start with 1 lb ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat. Break it apart as it browns, then add 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp red chili flakes, and a generous pinch of salt. Brown it up really well. 2️⃣ For the broth, add 2.5 tbsp red curry paste and 2 minced garlic cloves to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir for 1-2 mins until softened and fragrant. 3️⃣ Pour in 3/4 cup half-and-half (or coconut milk) and 1 cup Kettle & Fire bone broth. Stir everything together until smooth and bring to a gentle simmer. 4️⃣ Season the broth with a generous couple pinches salt, fresh lime juice, and freshly chopped cilantro. Taste and adjust to your liking. You want it creamy, savory, a little spicy, and bright from the lime. 5️⃣ For the quick pickled red onions, super thinly slice 1/2 large red onion and add it to a bowl. Add juice of 1 lemon and sprinkle with sea salt. Mix really well with a fork and let sit 5-10 mins to soften. 6️⃣ Prepare 4 servings rice of choice. I love replacing the water in mine with bone broth for extra flavor + protein. 7️⃣ To assemble, add 3/4 cup cooked rice to a bowl, add 1/4 of the seasoned beef, and ladle 1/4 of the broth over everything. 8️⃣ Top with thinly sliced cucumbers, quick pickled red onions, sesame seeds, Korean chili flakes and plenty of finely chopped fresh cilantro. If you make it, let me know what you think on SHREDHAPPENS! ENJOY! 🙌 #healthyrecipes #healthyfoodshare #goodmoodfood

Creamy Peri Peri Chicken Pasta🍗🧀🍝 Another game changing sheet pan meal prep. This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice This Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice is a cozy, comforting dinner featuring juicy golden chicken served over fluffy rice with a rich, buttery Parmesan garlic sauce. It's simple enough for busy weeknights but delicious enough to feel like a special homemade meal. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Add the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in the Parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and drizzle generously with the creamy garlic butter sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. Prep Time: 10 minutes | Cook Time: 25 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes Servings: 6 | Calories: About 620 per serving #dinner #easyrecipes #chicken #comfortfood #rice

Chicken Alfredo Tortellini Soup This soup is an easy one-pot dinner that’s perfect for a cozy night!  Ingredients 1 lb chicken breast, cubed 2 tbsp butter 1 sweet onion, diced 3 large carrots, diced Salt and black pepper, to taste 1 tsp garlic powder 1/4 cup all-purpose flour 4 cups chicken stock 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half 18 oz cheese tortellini 1 (6 oz) bag shredded Parmesan cheese 3 cups fresh spinach 1 tsp crushed red pepper flakes Directions 1. Melt the butter in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the diced onion and carrots. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and poultry seasoning. Cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables begin to soften. 2. Sprinkle the flour over the vegetables and stir well until everything is evenly coated. Cook for 1–2 minutes. 3. Slowly pour in the chicken stock, stirring continuously to incorporate the flour and create a smooth broth. 4. Add the cubed chicken breast and bring the broth to a boil. Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook until the chicken is cooked through.  5. Stir in the heavy cream or half-and-half, followed by the cheese tortellini. Cook according to the package directions until the tortellini are tender. 6. Reduce the heat to low and gradually stir in the shredded Parmesan cheese until melted and the soup is creamy. 7. Add the fresh spinach and crushed red pepper flakes. Stir for 1–2 minutes, or until the spinach is wilted. 8. Remove from the heat and let the soup sit for about 10–15 minutes before serving. This gives the soup time to thicken and allows all those flavors to come together. Serve warm with extra Parmesan and crushed red pepper on top! Recipe Note The tortellini will continue to soak up the broth as the soup sits, so don't worry if it initially looks a little thinner than you'd like. It will thicken considerably as it rests. If you have leftovers, the tortellini will continue absorbing liquid overnight in the refrigerator. When reheating, simply add a splash of chicken stock, milk, half-and-half, or cream to loosen the soup back up to your desired consistency. #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #soupseason #easydinner #quickrecipes

Save this recipe in @myrecipes so it's ready when you are. Ingredients: 2 cups white rice 1 (10.5-ounces) can condensed French onion soup 2 (10.5 ounce) cans condensed beef consomme 8 ounces baby portobello mushrooms, roughly chopped 1 cup grated Pecorino Romano or Parmesan cheese, divided 1 stick butter, cut into 8 pieces 2 pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 1/4 teaspoons kosher salt 3/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon onion powder 1 teaspoon paprika 1 tablespoon chopped parsley (optional) Directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Stir rice, French onion soup, beef consomme, and portobello mushrooms together in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with 3/4 cup of the cheese and add butter pieces on top. Season chicken evenly with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika and place on top of cheese and butter. Top with remaining cheese and cover dish with foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake until top is golden brown, liquid has been absorbed into the rice, and chicken is cooked through, about 20 more minutes. Sprinkle with fresh parsley if desired. Inspiration: @melissajorealrecipes 🧑‍🍳: @nicolemcmom #easydinners #dinnerideas #butter #chicken #chickenandrice

Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

Chocolate Brownie Lava Cake 🍫🌋 Ingredients: - For Chocolate Sponge - • 240g plain flour • 30g cocoa powder • 400g granulated sugar • 2tsp bicarbonate of soda • 1tsp baking powder • 240ml milk • 110g vegetable oil • 2 large eggs • 1tsp vanilla extract • 50g milk chocolate • 150ml hot water - For Chocolate Icing - • 250g unsalted butter • 500g icing sugar • 50g cocoa powder • 1tsp vanilla extract • 3tbsp milk - For Brownie Lava - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 70g unsalted butter • 40g cocoa powder • 40g plain flour (heat treated) • 80g double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 70g milk chocolate - For Brownie Bites - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 90g unsalted butter • 60g cocoa powder • 120g plain flour (heat treated) • 2-3tbsp double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 100g chocolate chips Instructions: - For Chocolate Sponge - 1) In a large bowl, combine your flour, cocoa powder, granulated sugar, bicarbonate of soda, and baking powder 2) In another bowl, whisk together your milk, vegetable oil, eggs, vanilla extract, and 50g melted milk chocolate 3) Fold in your dry ingredients from before and add in 150ml hot water or coffee 4) Line three 8” cake tins and pour in the batter evenly. Bake in the oven at 160°C fan for around 25 minutes - For Icing - 1) Whisk your butter until light and creamy 2) Add in your icing sugar and cocoa powder 3) Once incorporated, whisk in your vanilla and milk until fluffy  - For Brownie Lava - 1) Melt the butter with both sugars over a medium heat 2) Whisk in the cocoa powder and flour 3) Gradually add in the cream until molten and thick, then stir in the vanilla extract and salt 4) Let it cool to just above room temperature and then add in the milk chocolate to slowly melt in 5) Once the lava has reached room temperature, you can use it on your cake! - For Bronwie Bites - 1) Cream together the butter and both sugars until fluffy 2) Mix in the cocoa powder, flour, and salt until sandy 3) Add in the vanilla extract and double cream 4) Once it has become a dough, fold in your chocolate chips, then press it firmly into a lined 9x9” square tin, refrigerate for 30 minutes, then cut into small bite sized pieces  Watch the video to see how I build and decorate the cake! I find it’s easier to ice the sponges when they are frozen/cold. Enjoy! :) #chocolate #cake #brownie #baking #recipes

Fuss-free crockpot turkey? Are we hearing that right? 🫨 Sometimes, the shortcut *does* pay off in the end! This Viral Butterball Crockpot Turkey is everything @allyssainthekitchen says it is and more! Save this recipe and more favorites in the @myrecipes app. 🦃 Ingredients: 1 (3 pound) boneless turkey breast, such as Butterball®, with gravy packet 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder 1/2 teaspoon onion powder 1 1/2 teaspoons poultry seasoning 1 (1 ounce) packet onion soup mix 1 cup whole berry cranberry sauce 1/2 cup apple cider 3 tablespoons cold water 1 tablespoon cornstarch Directions: Remove gravy packet from turkey package and set aside. Leave netting around the turkey while cooking. Season turkey all over with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and poultry seasoning. Place seasoned turkey in a slow cooker. Top with onion soup mix and cranberry sauce. Pour cider around turkey and cook on High for 2 1/2 to 3 hours or on Low for 5 to 6 hours. Remove netting with kitchen shears and let turkey rest while sauce is prepared. Strain liquid from the slow cooker into a small saucepan; stir in reserved gravy packet and bring to a simmer. In a small bowl whisk together 3 tablespoon cold water and 1 tablespoon cornstarch until cornstarch is dissolved. Whisk cornstarch mixture into gravy and simmer until thickened. Slice turkey and serve with gravy. Inspiration: @allyssainthekitchen 🧑‍🍳: Nicole #turkey #butterball #crockpot #thanksgiving #turkeyrecipe

VIRAL CARROT WRAPS 🥕 I’ve made a vacation of these with zucchini, pickles, jalapeños, and I had to put a spin on them with carrots. These are probably my second favorite after the zucchini, they come out really good, super pliable/ and they are a touch sweeter which went really well with the toppings I used here. A medium carrot has about 4 net carbs, so this is a great lower carb option if you’re watching carbs. Recipe makes 3-4 wraps Here is how I made it: 1.Preheat oven to 375F.  2.Shred 3 medium carrots into a bowl. Crack in an egg, add 1 cup of shredded pepper jack cheese, toss in 1/2 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tbsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp chipotle pepper (optional), and a small pinch of salt. Mix really well. 3.Grab a cookie sheet, line with parchment paper (important!) and scoop the carrot mixture into circular shapes. You’ll get 3-4 good sized wraps here. 4.Pop it into the oven at 375F for 16-18 minutes. Then remove and let cool for a few minutes while you prep your fillings 5.I spread a base of my homemade guac here. Just mash 2 avocados with the juice of 1 lime, a large handful of freshly chopped cilantro, 1/2 small white onion, a couple pinches of salt, and about a tablespoon of toasted sesame seeds for crunch (optional).  6.I also added some leftover shredded beef (chicken or shrimp work just fine), topped with a tsp of sour cream, some sriracha, and more fresh cilantro. Again, use what you like here! 7.Plate them up and devour. If you make these, be sure to let me know on SHREDHAPPENS - these are a great lowcarb wrap or lower crab bread option, and a great way to sneak in some extra veggies. Cream chicken over biscuits with loaded bacon green beans! Such an easy comfort food dinner, and the homemade gravy is so good. I served mine over mashed potatoes with Cheddar Bay Biscuits on the side, but you can serve it right over the biscuits, too! Cream Chicken Over Biscuits Recipe Ingredients: 1 rotisserie chicken, shredded 2 tbsp butter 2 tbsp all purpose flour 2 cups water or chicken broth 1 tsp chicken bouillon Cheddar Bay Biscuits, prepared according to package instructions Mashed potatoes, for serving Seasonings: Dried parsley Garlic powder Onion powder Poultry seasoning Paprika Directions: Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat. Add the flour and stir well, letting it cook for about 2 minutes. Pour in the water or chicken broth and stir until smooth. Season to taste with parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, poultry seasoning, and paprika. Stir in the chicken bouillon and give everything a good stir. I skipped adding salt because the bouillon was salty enough! Let the gravy simmer for a few minutes, stirring occasionally, until it starts to thicken. Add the shredded rotisserie chicken and stir until everything is combined. Cover and let simmer for several minutes until the chicken is heated through and the gravy thickens to your liking. Prepare the Cheddar Bay Biscuits according to the package instructions. Serve the chicken gravy over mashed potatoes with biscuits on the side, or spoon it right over the biscuits! Loaded Bacon Green Beans Recipe Ingredients: 2 cans green beans, drained 2 slices thick cut bacon, chopped 1 tbsp butter 2 tbsp brown sugar 2 tbsp low sodium soy sauce Garlic powder Black pepper Directions: Cook the chopped bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy. Leave the bacon and bacon grease in the pan, then add the butter, drained green beans, brown sugar, soy sauce, garlic powder, and black pepper. Stir everything together, cover, and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, while you prepare the rest of dinner. Let the flavors come together until the green beans are tender! Save this one for your next weeknight dinner! #EasyDinnerIdeas #DinnerRecipes #WeeknightDinner #DinnerIdeas #EasyRecipe

Cook the chicken on medium - high heat for approximately 4 minutes on each side, once cooked set it aside. 3. Leave the chicken juice in the pan & cook diced brown onion, diced capsicum/bell peppers & diced garlic cloves until softened. 4. Add light butter to the middle of the pan with a bit of cajun seasoning & let the seasoning toast for approximately 1 minute, then add cooked white rice & mix well until fully incorporated. 5. Street Corn Chicken Bowls: Gut Healthy Edition 🌽 @Nature Made  Juicy spiced chicken, the most addictive green sauce you've ever made, and a zesty street corn salad. High protein, gut-healthy and paired with my daily Nature Made Probiotic + Prebiotic Fiber Gummies… weeknight approved 🫡 #partner For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp oregano, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -3 tbsp olive oil -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 lime, juiced For the Street Corn: -30 oz (850 g) corn kernels (or 4 cobs) -⅓ cup red onion, finely diced -1 fresh jalapeno, diced (deseeded) -½ avocado, cubed -¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped -⅓ cup cotija cheese (or feta), crumbled -Seasonings: 2 tsp chile lime, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -¼ cup greek yogurt -¼ cup mayonnaise -½ lime, juiced For the Aji Verde: -½ cup greek yogurt -½ cup mayonnaise  -1 small jalapeño, deseeded -1 1/2 cups cilantro, leaves and stems -4 to 5 garlic cloves -2 tsp black pepper -1 tsp salt -Juice of 1 lime Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic and lime juice. Mix well & marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. For even more flavor, char the corn in a hot skillet for 5–7 with a splash of neutral oil before mixing with the remaining street corn ingredients. Refrigerate. 3. To a food processor or blender, add all of the Aji Verde ingredients and blend until smooth & vibrant green. 4. I recommend making rice for the bowls! 2 cups of long grain white rice should do the trick. Once done, fluff with 2 tbsp olive oil, ¼ cup fresh cilantro and a splash of lime juice. 5. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat & add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden & cooked through. Set aside. 6. Assemble your bowls with the rice, chicken, street corn salad, a generous drizzle of aji verde, extra cotija, and fresh cilantro. Enjoy :)

DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Return to the oven uncovered at 400°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is tender and fully cooked (165°F internally). Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with green beans, a warm dinner roll, or whatever your heart desires! That’s the beauty of cooking. Make it how YOU like it! 🤎 Save this one for an easy, comforting weeknight dinner! #easymeal #easyrecipe #momlife #fallvibes #smotheredchicken

Pre heat air fryer to 380°F. Clean and trim off excess fat from chicken thighs and pat dry. Place chicken on a baking sheet or mixing bowl, add seasonings to taste. Drizzle with oil and mix to thoroughly combine ensuring all sides are evenly coated. 2. Air fry chicken thighs at 380°F for 12 to 18 minutes, flipping halfway through. Cook until the thickest part of the chicken reaches internal temp of 165°F. 3. While chicken is cooking make the bang bang sauce. Reserve some sauce for topping. Brush remaining sauce to coat top of each chicken thigh. Crank heat up to 400°F or if you have the @From Our Place air fryer like me, switch it to low broil. Cook for an additional 5 minutes until sauce thickens.  4. Serve with rice, garnish with reserved sauce, parsley or chopped green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

I’ve made ten jars like this, crimson pots, thrown crimson clay that’ll eventually be coated in a crimson glaze and then finally, they’ll be reduction fired, oh, there’s also some bronze in the mix, small fragments, which when put through the kiln turn into these red haloed flecks of metal. All of that might sound quite over the top but it’s a deep red with underlying tones of black and hopefully they resemble some of the tests I’ve fired in the past… fingers crossed. They require a different approach when crafting them, especially during the turning stage. As the particles of grog the body contains are constantly torn out I have to go back over the surface, burnishing it and smoothing it as I go to get rid of the overly prominent scratches these splinters of ceramic create. I lost a few pieces from attempting to fix oval openings, they were thrown round, but as clay slowly dries it’s quite common for it to subtlety warp. I tried to gentle press the opening back into a round shape and I felt something give; upon further inspection I found a hairline crack in the rim. Grogged clays might be tough during the throwing and the firing but it’s brittle stuff during the trimming stage, especially when trimmed as thinly as this. #clay #handmade #satisfying #pottery #ceramics

Dump & Bake Chicken Broccoli & Orzo Bake 🥦🧀🍗 If you love an easy, cheesy, comforting dinner, you need to try this one!  INGREDIENTS: • 1½–2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs • 2 cups uncooked orzo pasta • 3 cups fresh broccoli florets • 2¼ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1½ tsp salt, divided • 1 tsp black pepper, divided • 1½ tsp garlic powder, divided • 1 tsp onion powder, divided • 1 tsp paprika • 1 tsp dried oregano • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • 3 tbsp butter • 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. In a 9x13 baking dish, combine the uncooked orzo, broccoli, chicken broth, heavy cream, ½ tsp salt, ½ tsp black pepper, 1 tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp onion powder, and Italian seasoning. 3. Season the chicken thighs with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and italian seasoning 4. Place the chicken on top of the orzo mixture and add a little butter to each piece. 5. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 30 minutes. 6. Check the chicken and return it to the oven if it needs additional cooking time. 7. Remove the chicken and stir 1½ cups of shredded cheddar cheese into the orzo. 8. Place the chicken back on top and sprinkle with the remaining cheddar cheese. 9. Bake uncovered for another 15–20 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 165°F and the orzo is tender. Creamy, cheesy, and SO good! Save this one for your next dinner night! 🤍 #EasyDinnerIdeas #ChickenBroccoliOrzo #OnePanDinner #ComfortFoodRecipes #EasyRecipes

Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍯🧀🍟 By far one of the best combos i’ve made, all made around making meal prepping easy and effortless. The chicken is absolutely INCREDIBLE! Macros Per Serving (10 Total) 596 Calories | 54g Protein | 51g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Servings) Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken •Marinade - 1500g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, cubed - 3 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 130g Grated Parmigiano Reggiano - 45g Honey - 8 Tsp / 40g Olive Oil •After Cooking - Extra 15g Honey - Extra 20g Grated Parmesan - Parsley for garnish Crispy Roasted Potatoes - 1800g Raw White/Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 4 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - Olive Oil Cooking Spray, 5 seconds spray Creamy Parmesan Tuscan Sauce •Blender - 700g Fat Free Cottage Cheese - 250g Skimmed Milk - 250g Light Evaporated Milk •Pan - 30g Light Butter - 200g White Onion, finely chopped - 45g Garlic, finely chopped - 200g Sundried Tomatoes, drained & chopped - Handful Fresh Basil Leaves, roughly chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 100g Grated Parmesan - 20g Parmesan Rind Chunks Cooking Instructions 1. Cube chicken thighs. Add seasonings, Parmesan, honey and olive oil. Mix well and set aside. Prepare cream sauce. 2. Cube potatoes and add to a lined sheet pan. Season, spray generously with cooking spray and mix. Spread evenly and bake at 200C / 400F for 35-40 mins until golden and crispy. 3. Meanwhile, melt butter in a large pan over medium heat. Add onion, garlic and sun-dried tomatoes. Cook 10 mins until softened, then add seasonings and fresh basil. 4. Toast 2 mins, then reduce heat to low. Add cream sauce, Parmesan and Parmesan rind. Mix gently until creamy. Do not boil. 5. Remove potatoes. Spread chicken on the same sheet pan and bake at 190C / 380F for 20 mins, then broil/grill 5-6 mins until golden and juicy. Finish with honey and Parmesan. 6. Add crispy potatoes to the cream sauce and gently fold until well coated. Prepare the Chicken: 	•	In a bowl, mix chicken cubes with eggs, 2 Tbsp soy sauce, and black pepper. 	•	Add cornstarch and toss until chicken is well coated. 	2.	Fry the Chicken: 	•	Heat vegetable oil in a deep skillet or wok over medium-high heat. 	•	Fry chicken in batches for 5–7 minutes, until golden brown and cooked through. 	•	Remove and drain on paper towels. 	3.	Make the Honey Sauce: 	•	In a saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. 	•	Add garlic and red pepper flakes, sauté until fragrant. 	•	Stir in brown sugar, ¼ cup soy sauce, and honey. 🌈 SUPER SIMPLE TASTE-SAFE KINETIC SAND 🌈 If you’re looking for kid safe kinetic sand - this is it! It might not have the silicone binder that store bought has which gives a stretchy effect, but it’s made with 5 simple ingredients, that still gives it the ability to be squished and moulded while holding its shape and it crumbles like sand. It’s fun, cheap, and so easy to whip up… plus your little ones will love it! INGREDIENTS: 1 cup baking soda 1/2 cup sugar 3/4 cup cornflour  1 Tbsp cream of tartar 1/4 cup of water 1 tsp food colouring (optional) HOW TO: 1. Add the baking soda, sugar, cornflour, and cream of tartar to a large bowl, and stir  everything together. 2. In a small cup, mix your food colouring & water (if you’re using food colouring). 3. Add 2 Tbsp of the water into the dry mix and whisk together. If its still too powdery and doesn’t clump in your hands, add 1 Tbsp more of the water, and stir again. Repeat up to the full 1/4 cup of water, squishing with your hands to mix it in and get the right texture (note if you get heavy handed with the water, counterbalance it by adding equal parts cornflour & sugar, 1 Tbsp of each at a time) 4. Enjoy! NOTES: 🫙 Store in an airtight container in the fridge for 4–6 weeks. If it dries out a little, add 1–2 tsp of water and mix it through with your hands. 🌈  you can make the colour brighter by adding a few extra drops into the water at the beginning. 👶 whilst this recipe is taste-safe, make sure to supervise little ones closely as it’s not for eating by the handful.  . . . . . #kineticsand #toddler #kidsactivities #sensoryplay #playtolearn

Grilled Teriyaki Chicken 🔥🍗 Cook Like an Asian Ep 1: Grilled Teriyaki Chicken. Welcome to my series, where I teach you easy Asian recipes so good, your friends will think you’re Asian. 🤙🏽 Sweet, savory, garlicky chicken thighs grilled over charcoal for smoky flavor and a beautiful char. This is the series where I bring the recipes, and you take the credit. 🙌🏽 Ingredients: 2 lb boneless chicken thighs ½ cup shoyu (soy sauce) ½ cup brown sugar 5 garlic cloves, crushed 1 tbsp crushed ginger 1 tbsp sesame oil 1 tbsp rice vinegar 1 tsp mirin Instructions: 1. Mix the shoyu, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and mirin until combined. 2. Reserve ¼ cup of marinade BEFORE adding the raw chicken. Refrigerate separately for brushing during the cook. 3. Place chicken in a zip-top bag and pour in the remaining marinade. Seal, massage to coat, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or overnight. 4. Fire up your charcoal grill. Once the coals are hot, keep one side cooler so you can move the chicken if it browns too quickly.  5. Remove chicken from the bag and discard the used marinade. Grill over the hot coals, flipping and brushing both sides with the reserved marinade to build that beautiful char. 6. Move to the cooler side as needed to prevent burning, and cook until the thickest part reaches 165°F. 7. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice and serve with hot rice! 🍚 Don’t let these ingredients intimidate you because I got all of them from my local Walmart! #teriyakichicken #asianfood #easyrecipe

Sweet, savory, and packed with bold garlic flavor 🧄🍗 — this Garlic Brown Sugar Chicken is sticky, caramelized perfection and comes together fast! ⸻ 🍗 Garlic Brown Sugar Chicken ⭐ Ingredients 	•	4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (or thighs) 	•	Salt & black pepper 	•	1 tsp paprika 	•	2 tbsp olive oil Garlic Brown Sugar Sauce: 	•	½ cup packed brown sugar 	•	4 cloves garlic, minced 	•	2 tbsp soy sauce 	•	1 tbsp Dijon mustard (optional, for depth) 	•	1 tbsp apple cider vinegar or lemon juice 	•	½ tsp crushed red pepper (optional) ⸻ 👩‍🍳 Directions 	1.	Season chicken: Pat chicken dry and season both sides with salt, pepper, and paprika. 	2.	Sear: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken 4–5 minutes per side until golden brown. 	3.	Make sauce: In a bowl, whisk together brown sugar, garlic, soy sauce, mustard, vinegar, and red pepper flakes. 	4.	Simmer: Reduce heat to medium-low. Pour sauce into skillet. Spoon sauce over chicken and simmer 5–7 minutes until sauce thickens and chicken is cooked through. 	5.	Serve: Spoon extra caramelized garlic sauce over top before serving. ⸻ 🍽️ Serve With 	•	White or jasmine rice 	•	Roasted broccoli 	•	Mashed potatoes ⸻ ✨ Tips 	•	Chicken thighs stay extra juicy 	•	For thicker sauce, simmer a few extra minutes 	•	Add a splash of pineapple juice for a sweet tropical twist Sticky, garlicky, and perfectly sweet — a guaranteed weeknight favorite 💛 #foodie #foodtok #recipe #dinner #chicken

Cozy & Affordable Baked Chicken Dinner 🍗🤎 Tonight I was going for cozy, comforting, and affordable, and this is one of my go-to dinners when I want something simple but still really good. Ingredients: * Chicken legs * Olive oil * Garlic powder * Onion powder * Paprika * Seasoning salt * Black pepper * Italian seasoning * 1 orange bell pepper, sliced * 1 green bell pepper, sliced * 1 onion, sliced * 2 cans cream of mushroom soup * ½–1 cup chicken broth * Jasmine rice * French-style green beans * Buttermilk biscuits * Honey for glazing Instructions: 1. Season the chicken legs with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, seasoning salt, black pepper, and Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and mix well so the seasoning coats the chicken. 3. Slice the peppers and onion. 4. Sauté the peppers and onions in a skillet until they begin to soften. 5. Add the cream of mushroom soup and chicken broth. Stir until smooth and creamy. 6. Place the seasoned chicken in a baking dish and pour the creamy mixture over the top. 7. Bake at 375°F for about 50–60 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 165°F internally and is fully cooked. 8. Serve with jasmine rice, French-style green beans, and a warm buttermilk biscuit finished with a little honey. Affordable, filling, and the perfect comfort dinner. There are so many good recipes out there, but truthfully I’ve always had a hard time finding one that actually works for the season of life I’m in. My husband works late and I have two little girls, so weeknight dinner is on me, and most nights I just don’t have the time, the energy, or the headspace for a lot of recipes. That’s pretty much why I started making my own dinners, and I hope other moms, or honestly anyone, can appreciate them, because to me they’re actually so easy. DUMB DINNERS Broccoli Cheddar Chicken Orzo INGREDIENTS 1 box (16 oz) orzo, uncooked 1 tub (32 oz) Panera broccoli cheddar soup 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth 3 cups shredded rotisserie chicken 1 tsp garlic powder ½ tsp black pepper a few shakes Frank’s RedHot 1 bag (12 oz) frozen broccoli florets 1 bag (8 oz) shredded extra-sharp cheddar a big handful Cheez-Its, crushed HOW TO MAKE IT Heat the oven to 375°F. Spray a 9×13 dish. Dump in the orzo, soup, broth, and chicken. Sprinkle on the garlic powder, pepper, and hot sauce. Dump in the frozen broccoli straight from the bag. Stir well so the orzo is under the liquid. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 375°F for 40 minutes. Uncover and stir. It should look loose and creamy. Stir in half the cheddar. Top with the rest, then the crushed Cheez-Its. Bake uncovered 5 more minutes. Let it sit 10 minutes before serving. Taste before adding any salt. #creatorsearchinsights #easydinnerideas #easyrecipe #easymeal #dinnerideas

My Wife’s Current Favorite Dinner! ❤️ In southern Italy, you’ll often find meat already coated in seasoned breadcrumbs at butcher shops and supermarket meat counters. It’s usually simple breadcrumbs, parsley, and grated cheese. My wife has been requesting these veal cutlets a lot lately, and I’m not complaining because it’s an easy dinner!  Veal Cutlets 🇮🇹 Ingredients 1 lb (500 g) veal cutlets Plain breadcrumbs Parmigiano Reggiano, grated Fresh parsley, chopped Paprika Salt and black pepper Extra virgin olive oil Instructions 1. Pound the veal cutlets thin and cut into smaller pieces. 2. In a bowl, mix the breadcrumbs, Parmigiano Reggiano, parsley, paprika, salt, and pepper. 3. Press the cutlets into the breadcrumb mixture, coating both sides. 4. Heat a generous amount of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. 5. Cook the cutlets for about 2 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through. 6. Serve with a fresh tomato salad and Italian bread.

🧀 Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans 🍗🥔 This Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans is an easy sheet-pan dinner packed with bold flavor. Juicy oven-roasted chicken is coated in a crispy Parmesan crust, while buttery garlic potatoes and tender green beans roast alongside for a complete, satisfying family meal with minimal cleanup. Ingredients For the Chicken • 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts • 2 tbsp olive oil • ¾ cup grated Parmesan cheese • ½ cup panko breadcrumbs • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • ½ tsp smoked paprika • ¾ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper For the Potatoes • 1½ lbs baby Yukon Gold potatoes, halved • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp melted butter • 1 tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp paprika • Salt and black pepper, to taste For the Green Beans • 12 oz fresh green beans, trimmed • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp melted butter • Salt and black pepper, to taste For Garnish • 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley • Lemon wedges Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Lightly grease a large sheet pan or line it with parchment paper. 2. Toss the potatoes with olive oil, melted butter, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Spread them evenly on one side of the pan and roast for 15 minutes. 3. In a shallow bowl, combine the Parmesan cheese, panko breadcrumbs, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. 4. Brush both sides of the chicken breasts with olive oil, then press them firmly into the Parmesan mixture until well coated. 5. Remove the sheet pan from the oven and move the potatoes to one side. Arrange the coated chicken in the center. 6. Toss the green beans with olive oil, melted butter, minced garlic, salt, and pepper, then place them beside the chicken. 7. Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) and the potatoes are fork-tender. 8. Switch the oven to broil and cook for 2–3 minutes until the Parmesan crust is extra crispy and golden. 9. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve with lemon wedges. Serving Suggestions Serve with Caesar salad, garlic bread, roasted carrots, steamed broccoli, or creamy ranch dipping sauce for a complete restaurant-style dinner. Storage Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days. Reheat in the oven or air fryer to keep the chicken crispy. Creamy Chicken in 20 Minutes! Weeknights can get a little hectic, and sometimes you just need something quick and easy for dinner! Nothing beats a good chicken dinner, especially when it looks and tastes like something you’d order at a nice Italian restaurant! The best part is you don’t have to spend hours in the kitchen to make something this good. Pollo alla Valdostana Ingredients 1 lb (450 g) thin chicken cutlets 1/4 lb (115 g) prosciutto cotto (Italian cooked ham) 1/3 lb (150 g) Fontina cheese, shredded 1/2 cup white wine 1/2 cup chicken or vegetable broth (plus an extra 1/2 cup for more sauce) Flour Extra virgin olive oil Knob of butter Salt and pepper Fresh parsley Instructions 1. Heat olive oil and a knob of butter in a pan over medium-high heat. 2. While the butter melts, lightly flour the chicken cutlets and place them directly into the pan. 3. Cook for about 2 minutes per side, seasoning with salt and pepper. 4. Add the white wine and let it reduce for a minute or two. 5. Pour in the broth, then top each cutlet with prosciutto cotto, Fontina cheese, and fresh parsley. 6. Cover and simmer until the chicken is cooked through, the cheese melts, and the sauce thickens. #chicken #easyrecipe #fyp

Oui, la France a officiellement reconnu la guerre d’Algérie en 1999. Mais pour moi, reconnaître qu’une guerre a existé, ce n’est pas la même chose que reconnaître pleinement les crimes commis, les souffrances endurées et les responsabilités historiques. J’ai le sentiment que cette partie de l’histoire est encore trop minimisée et qu’elle mérite d’être davantage enseignée et transmise. Derrière les dates, il y a des vies brisées, des familles endeuillées et des victimes dont l’histoire mérite d’être entendue et respectée. Je suis tunisienne, et je ne prétends pas parler à la place des Algériens. Mais je pense que la mémoire des victimes nous concerne tous. Je sais que certaines personnes ne seront peut-être pas d’accord avec moi, et que certaines se désabonneront peut-être de mon compte. Et ce n’est pas grave. Je préfère rester authentique, exprimer ce que je pense et parler des sujets qui me semblent importants plutôt que de me taire pour plaire à tout le monde.#Algérie

Dump & Bake Creamy Chicken & Orzo Creamy, cozy, packed with flavor, and the best part? Everything gets dumped into one dish. 🙌 Minimal prep, minimal cleanup, and absolutely no excuse not to have dinner on the table. Just try it! Ingredients * 1 cup dry orzo * 2 cups chicken broth * ½ cup heavy cream * Salt & pepper, to taste * Sun-dried tomatoes, as much as you like * 1 can artichoke hearts, drained * 1 large handful baby spinach * Chicken thighs * Garlic powder * Onion powder * Paprika * Olive oil * Grated Parmesan cheese Directions Preheat oven to 375°F. In a 9x13-inch baking dish, add the orzo, chicken broth, heavy cream, salt, pepper, sun-dried tomatoes, artichoke hearts, and spinach. Give everything a good mix. Season the chicken thighs generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika. Nestle them right into the orzo mixture and drizzle the tops with a little olive oil. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 30 minutes. Remove from the oven, take off the foil, and give the orzo a good stir around the chicken. Sprinkle with grated Parmesan and return to the oven uncovered for another 10 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the orzo is tender and creamy. That’s it! One dish, barely any prep, and dinner is DONE. 👏 #dumpandbake #chickenandorzo #weeknightdinners #easyrecipes #chicken
